class.name: Spline2DViewportEditor
class.brief_description: Direct 2D Scene Viewport editor for SplineNode2D and SplinePolygon2D.
class.description: Integrates into Godot's 2D CanvasItem editor via [IdeamSplinesPlugin] to let you select, drag, add, delete, and adjust Bezier tangent handles directly on [SplineNode2D] and [SplinePolygon2D] nodes in the 2D scene space. Uses [constant IdeamToolContext.UPDATE_ON_COMMIT] by default (with an optional Live toggle in the 2D toolbar) so each drag produces a single undo/redo step.
